credit.text: Remote MCP server list from punkpeye/awesome-remote-mcp-servers (MIT)

notes: MIT, same operator as glama and as awesome-mcp-servers (Copyright © 2026 Frank Fiegel, frank@glama.ai). Unlike the server list this one is about *running deployments*: each entry is a name, a homepage and the endpoint URL an agent would actually connect to — which makes it the more useful of the two for anything the lab does, because an endpoint is probeable. 1,071 entries, 379 KB. Ingested as a census (ingest/awesome-remote-mcp-servers.json), not mirrored.
